module_summary: main_exploit_installer.c is the memory-card system-update exploit installer: console identification (ROMVER/model/DTL/arcade), payload selection from embedded .incbin blobs, MagicGate binding via libsecr, optional custom-ELF KELF signing (kelf_signer), free-space estimation, folder wipe/create and the card writes; its menus/messages/progress are routed through the exploitInstallerUi callback table that dash_exploit.c installs, with a classic uLE drawing fallback. main_fileops.c holds small path helpers (wleExists, uLE_related, file-type tests). main_gameid.c/main_gameid_table.c build a title ID for a launch path or PS1 disc (PVD timestamp table derived from OSDMenu) and draw the Retro GEM optical Game ID packet. main_history.c updates the OSDSYS BxDATA-SYSTEM/history file on both cards. main_info_screens.h only declares the classic info screens.

reusable_helpers.name: wleExists
reusable_helpers.what: returns 1 if genOpen of a path succeeds (file exists test)

reusable_helpers.name: uLE_related
reusable_helpers.what: resolves uLE:/ paths to LaunchElfDir or mc0/mc1 SYS-CONF

reusable_helpers.name: build_sibling_file_path
reusable_helpers.what: replaces the file name of a path with another file name, bounded

reusable_helpers.name: append_filename_to_path
reusable_helpers.what: joins dir + name, adding a slash if needed, bounded

reusable_helpers.name: starts_with_model / model_contains
reusable_helpers.what: case-insensitive prefix test and case-insensitive substring search

reusable_helpers.name: bytes_to_mc_kb
reusable_helpers.what: rounds a byte count up to 1 KB memory-card clusters

reusable_helpers.name: wipe_mc_folder
reusable_helpers.what: recursive memory-card folder delete via mcGetDir/mcDelete

reusable_helpers.name: check_memory_card
reusable_helpers.what: mcGetInfo with retries; checks PS2 type and formatted, returns free KB

reusable_helpers.name: displayRetroGemGameID
reusable_helpers.what: draws the Retro GEM optical Game ID packet with its own gsKit context

reusable_helpers.name: buildLaunchGameID
reusable_helpers.what: extracts an 11-char title ID from a launch path or falls back to PS1 PVD lookup

findings.title: Classic-UI fallback drawing code in main_exploit_installer.c is dead in the dashboard build (exploitInstallerUi is always set)
findings.problem: Every dashboard route to the installer (dashRunMisc at dash_main.c:474-476, reached from tools, home, browser and launch keys; dash_main.c:398-399 refuses to send it to ExecuteMainAction) goes through dashExploitInstaller, which sets exploitInstallerUi with all five callbacks non-NULL (dash_exploit.c:148,159). The classic menu loop, OK dialog (a copy of gui.c ynDialog layout), progress box, info page, console box, button helpers and getFilePath pickers only run when exploitInstallerUi is NULL, i.e. via main_actions.c:803, which only a hand-edited MISC path in a non-dashboard ExecuteMainAction caller could reach.
findings.fix: Delete the classic fallback branches (draw_console_info_box, the classic half of draw_install_progress, is_ok_button/is_cancel_button, the classic loops of choose_from_menu, ok_result_dialog and show_exploit_installer_info, and the getFilePath fallbacks) and call the exploitInstallerUi callbacks directly. Make main_actions.c:802-804 call dashExploitInstaller() so the UI table is always installed.
findings.benefit: ~170 source lines removed; main_exploit_installer.o .text is 23,592 bytes (MEASURED, BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:88); the fallback is reachable through a runtime NULL test so gc cannot drop it, estimated ~2 KB .text saved (INFERRED from line share)
findings.evidence: Grep exploitInstallerUi over the repo: set only at dash_exploit.c:159 (cleared at :161), read only in main_exploit_installer.c. ShowExploitInstaller callers: dash_exploit.c:160 and main_actions.c:803. ExecuteMainAction callers: dash_main.c:442 (returns early for Misc_Exploit_Installer at :398-399), dash_main.c:669 (dashLaunchApp, device paths), main.c:265 via Execute() for IGR after-path (picked with ext ELF, dash_settings.c:2074), executeBrowserSelection (classic filer, reached only from Misc_FileBrowser/TextEditor/ExecuteBrowserFrom, the last has no caller). INFERRED part: that no supported path hands the MISC exploit path to ExecuteMainAction. No test references main_exploit_installer.c.

findings.title: copy_printable_prefix is copied verbatim from main_console_info.c
findings.problem: The 21-line static copy_printable_prefix in main_exploit_installer.c is byte-for-byte the same as the static one in main_console_info.c; the installer already includes main_console_info.h.
findings.fix: Make the main_console_info.c copy non-static, add its prototype to main_console_info.h and delete the installer copy.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed; one copy of a small function (tens of bytes, INFERRED) dropped from .text
findings.evidence: Read both bodies side by side (installer 248-268, main_console_info.c 7-27): identical. dupes-blocks.tsv line 115 reports the same pair. main_console_info.c uses it at :59 and :164; installer at :290. main_exploit_installer.c:4 includes main_console_info.h.

findings.title: Unreachable repeated conditions and redundant tests in main_exploit_installer.c
findings.problem: build_magicgate_result_message tests console_is_PSX twice; the second block (with a hard-coded English message) can never run. get_psx_desr_payload repeats the dtl_signing_console test at 539-540 after already returning for it at 535-536. build_install_plan's EXPLOIT_MODE_MG_TEST case is unreachable (MG test is handled at 2424 before the call). get_custom_payload_header 409-410 and get_custom_payload_keyset 395-397 return the same value as their fall-through. starts_with_model("COH") already covers "COH-H", and model_contains("PYTHON") covers "PYTHON 1"/"PYTHON1".
findings.fix: Delete the second console_is_PSX block, the repeated dtl test, the MG_TEST case, the two redundant if branches and the three subsumed model tests.
findings.benefit: ~18 lines removed; a dead 170-byte English string literal and a few compares leave .rodata/.text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read 2106-2116: identical condition, first branch returns. Read 533-541: 535 returns on dtl_signing_console, info unchanged before 539. ShowExploitInstaller 2424-2430 breaks out for MG_TEST before build_install_plan at 2432. 409-412 both return KELF_SIGN_HEADER_DNASLOAD; 395-400 both return "retail". starts_with_model is a prefix test (313-328), model_contains a substring test (330-342).

findings.title: folder_for_asset switch and six NULL checks that cannot fire; folder names stored twice
findings.problem: folder_for_asset is a 15-line switch mapping the four FOLDER_ASSET values to fixed names, and every caller loops i < FOLDER_ASSET_COUNT, so its NULL return and the six 'if (folder == NULL) continue' checks can never happen. The same four names are also repeated as string fields in all ten ps2_targets rows, next to the asset index that already identifies them.
findings.fix: Replace the switch with a static const char *const array indexed by asset, delete the six NULL checks, and drop the folder field from ps2_targets in favour of the array lookup by .asset.
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed; ten pointer fields (40 bytes) of ps2_targets dropped (INFERRED: 10 x 4-byte pointers)
findings.evidence: Read all folder_for_asset callers: 1256, 1281, 1661, 1747, 1779, 1931, each inside for (i = 0; i < FOLDER_ASSET_COUNT; i++). The switch covers all four enum values (47-54). ps2_targets folder strings match folder_for_asset(asset) in every row (115-124). .folder is read at 1586, 1910.

findings.title: Size-estimate error plumbing for embedded blobs that cannot be missing (add_size_kb and repeated blob checks)
findings.problem: All payloads and icon.sys files are .incbin blobs with build-time sizes (embed_blobs.S:53-63) and get_payload/get_icon_sys always set data/body consistently for every enum value used, yet payload_size_kb, folder_asset_file_size_kb and sign_payload_to_memory re-check for NULL/zero/inconsistent blobs, and add_size_kb exists only to forward these impossible negative values through four call sites.
findings.fix: Have payload_size_kb and folder_asset_file_size_kb return the KB count directly, delete add_size_kb and the four error checks in estimate_install_file_kb, and drop the repeated blob checks in sign_payload_to_memory.
findings.evidence: Read embed_blobs.S:53-63 (all exploit_* blobs EMBED_FILE/SLICE/TAIL with size_ words), get_payload 483-517 (every case sets data/size; body only with body_size), get_icon_sys 557-581, bytes_to_mc_kb 583-589 (never negative). add_size_kb callers: 623, 626, 1834, 1840, 1849 only.

findings.title: Small in-file duplicates in main_exploit_installer.c (signing call, card-write tail, file-exists test, folder_assets_to_write)
findings.problem: export_custom_payload repeats the keyset drawMsg and KelfSignElfToMemory call of build_custom_payload_to_memory (header_id resolves the same for PS2). write_signed_payload and install_system_xlf_targets inline the build_mc_path/drawMsg/write_blob body of write_custom_payload_buffer. mc_boot_elf_exists re-implements wleExists. prepare_needed_folders recomputes folder_assets_to_write with the result build_folder_assets_to_write already gives.
findings.fix: Call build_custom_payload_to_memory(custom, KELF_SIGN_SYSTEM_PS2, ...) from export_custom_payload; use write_custom_payload_buffer at 1403 and 1910; replace mc_boot_elf_exists with snprintf + wleExists; call build_folder_assets_to_write in prepare_needed_folders before the wipe.
findings.evidence: custom->header_id comes from get_custom_payload_header (DONGLE/FMCB/DNASLOAD); custom_payload_header_for_system(custom, PS2) maps those to the same values (228-237). write_custom_payload_buffer 1493-1500 is exactly the three statements at 1403-1405 and 1910-1912. mc_boot_elf_exists 1785-1797 = genOpen RDONLY/genClose like wleExists main_fileops.c:7-16. After a successful wipe under DELETE, !mc_folder_exists is 1, matching build_folder_assets_to_write 1774-1776.

findings.title: Needless indirections: install_for_plan forwarding wrapper and main_history evictedEntry temp copy
findings.problem: install_for_plan only unpacks plan into install_selected_ps2_updates and has one caller (2491). processHistoryList copies the evicted entry into a local only to pass it as a const pointer to appendEvictedHistoryEntry; the original is not modified until the memset after the call.
findings.fix: Delete install_for_plan and call install_selected_ps2_updates directly; pass newEntry to appendEvictedHistoryEntry and delete evictedEntry and the memcpy.
findings.benefit: ~7 lines removed; 24-byte stack copy avoided (INFERRED: sizeof(OSDHistoryEntry) = 16+4+2+pad)
findings.evidence: grep install_for_plan: definition 2277 and call 2491 only. main_history.c:67 appendEvictedHistoryEntry takes const OSDHistoryEntry *; 145-149 memcpy then call then memset.

findings.title: mcMkDir-and-accept-exists helper written twice (ensure_mc_folder and ensureHistoryDirectory)
findings.problem: Both functions run mcSync, mcMkDir(port, 0, dir), mcSync and map 0/-4 to success with the same five lines.
findings.fix: Make ensure_mc_folder's mkdir part a shared non-static helper (without its exists probe) and call it from ensureHistoryDirectory.
findings.evidence: grep '== -4)' and mcMkDir over src: identical pattern in main_exploit_installer.c:1166-1170 and main_history.c:60-64; filer_actions.c:2228-2239 and config.c:367 use different handling.

findings.title: PS1 PVD timestamp table and Retro GEM packet drawing duplicated in POPSLoader retrogem.cpp
findings.problem: The 124-entry OSDMenu-derived timestamp-to-title-ID table (dupes-blocks reports 123 identical normalised lines) and the Retro GEM packet build/CRC/sprite loop exist in both repos. The table is upstream-derived data.
findings.fix: No deletion is possible inside one repo. Keep one copy as the reference (Launchstation's, which names its OSDMenu source) and update both together; do not let them drift.
findings.benefit: Cross-repo note only; 0 lines removed in Launchstation
findings.evidence: Read POPSLoader/src/retrogem.cpp:1-60 (same table header) and 466-523 (rg_crc identical to calculateRetroGemCRC main_gameid.c:13-22; same A5/00/crc/len/id/00/D5/00 packet and x/y layout as main_gameid.c:58-89). Lead: dupes-blocks main_gameid_table.c:10-58/60-133 == retrogem.cpp:56-104/105-178.
